question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

This initiative has been sharply criticised as grossly inefficient and _______
solution:
The correct answer is: **Counterproductive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Counterproductive **means having the opposite of the desired effect or outcome. (उल्टा)
 
• In this context, it means that the initiative is not achieving its intended goals and may even be causing harm.
